met_analysis:
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Punjab & neighbourhood between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level with the trough aloft in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Haryana & neighbourhoodat 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south coastal Tamil Nadu and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from upper air cyclonic circulation over south coastal Tamil Nadu to Northwest Bay of Bengal off Odisha coast across Southwest & Westcentral Bay of Bengal extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from northeast Uttar Pradesh to Eastcentral Arabian sea across East Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southeast Arabian Sea & adjoining Lakshadweep between 1.5 & 4.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from upper air cyclonic circulation over southeast Arabian Sea & adjoining Lakshadweep to northwest Arabian Sea at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
